name: Question 7
problem: The displacement $s$ (in meters) relative to a fixed origin $O$ of a particle moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis is given by $s(t)={e}^{{t}^{2}-4t+6}$, where $t\ge 0$ is the time measured in seconds. Find the time intervals in which the particle is moving in the direction of decreasing $x.$

Question 7

The displacement s (in meters) relative to a fixed origin O of a particle moving in a straight line along the x-axis is given by s(t)=et2−4t+6, where t≥0 is the time measured in seconds. Find the time intervals in which the particle is moving in the direction of decreasing x.

a
[0,1) and (2,+∞)
b
[0,2)
c
(2,+∞)
d
(3,4)
e
(1,2) and (4,8)
